Definition: adverb from G459; lawlessly, i.e. (specially) not amenable to (the Jewish) law:--without law.
BiblicalUsage: Paul says those who have sinned without law shall perish without law, while those under the law shall be judged by the law. The adverb names the state of being outside the law, Gentiles judged apart from Moses' law.
TheologicalSignificance: One adverb about sinning without law carries no system of its own; its point is Paul's, that no one escapes judgment by never having heard the law.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
